releases.notes:
A new YAKO version, straight to your house! (yes you right there!)
---

This one's a big one! Very many changes, so much time getting things to work, but I think its worth it, so enjoy!

---
The main features in this update:
 - A new statistics tab that shows various statistics regarding your keystroke presses (Tracks statistics for each profile)
 - Overhauled the settings, can change the alpha individually & can change text color
 - Pressed text can now also be changed & the text preview is also now correctly displayed
 - Updated the saving and loading, so that old config now actually convert to new versions
 - Disabling the Keystrokes now works properly and also disabled the sound
 - Fixed a bug where the input switcher was available on the second page
 - Added command suggestion for /set /remove & /rename

---

There is still a bunch of bigger features I want to implement, so please stay tuned for that, but for now, please enjoy this release!

The mod is now on CurseForge & Modrinth and with that, I want the mod to be as accessible as possible. That being said, the `/yako remove` command was broken and caused crashes so this update had to come asap.

 - A welcome screen that explains the mod to the user (will only show up once)
 - Customizable text colors! 
 -  a new coat for the edit screen to accommodate the new and future settings (2 pages)
 - removed owo-lib
 - various bug fixes :tm:  

---

that being said, the next update is also expected to come rather sooner, because I still havent implemented UI scaling, which the mod needs asap.

releases.notes:
The third release of YAKM! 🎉 🎈
First things first! I've changed the name of the project to "Yet Another Keystrokes Overlay", also YAKO for short. This was initially due to CurseForge rejecting mods having the word mod in the name, but it also has the pleasant side effect, that the acronym is now cleaner. 

Now to the new features. The biggest addition is "Keystroke Sounds :tm: ", which are sounds that you can activate, that give audio feedback when pressing keystrokes (except for mouse clicks), in form of 3 different profiles. The sounds are created and recorded by hainguyents13, who is the creator of the "Mechvibes" project. The exact sound names are also present in the SOUND_ATTRIBUTION.txt. 

There are also plenty of new commands, which are access through `/yako` . For the entire command list, read the readme or do `/yako help <command>`. 

Some smaller new features are the full preview of a selected keystroke with all its features, being able to choose your own text for a keystroke and switching to a different default lettering (text on a keystroke).
